raw_text:
Containerize the specified ASP.NET **.NET Framework** project for Windows Docker only; no infrastructure setup or unrelated code changes. Use the supplied settings/defaults for project, Windows SKU/version, images, ports, user, IIS, build steps, dependencies, registry, environment, files, exclusions, health check, and special requirements.

Review settings; create `progress.md`; detect `TargetFrameworkVersion` in `.csproj`; select compatible Windows image. **IMPORTANT:** Use a Windows Server Core base image unless the user has **specifically requested** a full Windows Server image in the settings file.

Check for `Microsoft.Configuration.ConfigurationBuilders.Environment`. **DO NOT** install these if they are missing. If they are not installed, the user must install them manually. If they are not installed, pause executing this prompt and ask the user to install them using the Visual Studio NuGet Package Manager or Visual Studio package manager console.

Configure `web.config` EnvironmentConfigBuilder for appSettings and connectionStrings. Create `LogMonitorConfig.json` from the supplied reference: contents **MUST NOT** not be modified unless settings specify otherwise; preserve EventLog issue levels.

Create root Dockerfile and `.dockerignore`. Build stage MUST use `mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/framework/sdk` unless custom; copy sln, csproj, packages.config, and existing NuGet.config before restore; configure feeds, restore, then copy source and MSBuild-publish to `C:\publish`. Runtime stage MUST use `mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/framework/aspnet` unless custom. Copy publish output; download `https://github.com/microsoft/windows-container-tools/releases/download/v2.1.1/LogMonitor.exe`; configure dependencies, user, ports, and optional HEALTHCHECK. Use `ENTRYPOINT [ "C:\\LogMonitor\\LogMonitor.exe", "C:\\ServiceMonitor.exe", "w3svc" ]`. Add `<None Include="Dockerfile" />` to project.

Track and check off all progress items; run `docker build -t aspnet-app:latest .`, fix failures, and report result. Do not pause for confirmation between steps. **YOU ARE NOT DONE UNTIL ALL CHECKBOXES ARE MARKED!**
